channel.desc: Aled Jones and Rev Kate Bottley host this year's BBC Young Chorister of the Year, which begins with the junior semi-final at Hall? St Peter's in Manchester. Once again, Songs of Praise and BBC Radio 2 have come together to showcase the best young vocal talents, beginning with five talented singers aged 11 to 13 who perform a sacred song for expert judges David Grant, Laura Wright and Cameron Richardson.
